title: Flat base change for proper global sections
statement: Let $R$ be a ring, let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ be proper, and let $R\to R'$ be a flat ring map with $U=\operatorname{Spec}R'$ and $X_U=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}R}U$. The canonical base-change map $H^0(X,\mathcal O_X)\otimes_RR'\to H^0(X_U,\mathcal O_{X_U})$ is an isomorphism. In particular, if $H^0(X,\mathcal O_X)=R$, then $H^0(X_U,\mathcal O_{X_U})=R'$.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 30.5.2 (Tag 02KH, label coherent-lemma-flat-base-change-cohomology), the quasi-compact quasi-separated flat-base-change lemma specialized here to the proper morphism and degree $0$, used in the proof of More on Morphisms Theorem 37.53.5

proof.text: Properness supplies quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness. The affine base is compact, so QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace gives CompactSpace X, and quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated gives QuasiSeparatedSpace X. Module.Flat R S makes algebraMap R S flat by RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff; Flat.SpecMap_iff then makes Spec S -> Spec R flat. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-global-sections-qcqs] through the proved upstream isPushout_appTop_of_flat, which specializes Mathlib.isIso_pushoutSection_of_isQuasiSeparated_of_flat_right to the top opens. This gives the required pushout of the canonical section maps.

If GammaSpecIso.inv followed by f.appTop is an isomorphism, cancel the first isomorphism with isIso_comp_left_iff to deduce IsIso f.appTop. The opposite arrow in the pushout is an isomorphism by IsPushout.isIso_inr_of_isIso. Composing it with GammaSpecIso.inv over S proves the final clause.
